messages:
jess: quick check — planning to merge PR #4821 (timelock-secrets-rot): removes legacy KMS proxy endpoint and flips to tenant-specific KMS path. Merge targeted tomorrow 06:00 UTC. Any onprem/VPC egress impact? @mike @tanvi

mike: can you paste the diff for where KMS_URL is set? if it's only server-side default swap we're probably fine. thx

jess: snippet:
```bash
# old
export KMS_PROXY_URL=\"https://kms-proxy.internal\"
# new
export KMS_ENDPOINT=\"projects/${TENANT}/locations/global/keyRings/rw/cryptoKeys/primary\"
```
We're removing proxy fallback and reading from secret manager per-tenant.

tanvi: that changes outbound destination from our proxy to google kms (public). Onprem customers using private VPC peering would need egress rules. which customers are onprem?

jess: only acme-inc uses onprem in this rollout (they opted into private deployment). I pinged their infra earlier, they have a deny-all egress policy and rely on our proxy.

ryan: @jess do NOT merge until we have either (a) a KMS tunnel for acme-inc, or (b) feature-flag to keep proxy for private deployments. otherwise we break their deploy. filing sec review now.

sec-bot: [automated] Secret-scan: no plaintext secrets detected in PR #4821. SCA: low-risk. (report: https://ci/reports/4821).

mike: agreed with ryan. easiest is feature-flag. also need to add a note in private-deploy docs about required egress for direct KMS.

jess: ok i'll add feature-flag gate and doc change. how fast can we get approval? we were hoping to merge tomorrow 06:00 UTC.

ryan: timeline: I can review the flag + docs by EOD today if you post a small follow-up. if acme needs patching earlier, we can schedule a short maintenance with them.

tanvi: also confirm KMS key permissions — make sure the service account used for direct KMS access is scoped to tenant key only. don't widen to organization keys.

jess: will do. adding checklist:
- add feature-flag (default: enabled for hosted, disabled for private)
- docs note for private egress
- restrict SA perms to tenant key
- add canary with acme-inc
I'll post updated PR link @ryan when ready.

ryan: :thumbsup: thanks. hold merge until I say go.
